{{Top|leg}}
A '''senior assistant''' was a role within [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] society. They assisted the Gree [[Master (Gree)|masters]] in operating [[Gree technology]] while they waited for their chance to become masters themselves. Occasionally, senior assistants were elevated to the rank of master when they were recognized as the most profound expert within their field.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>
